draftInteractions.plan: Stand near the ally Irelia wants to reach and save Steadfast Presence for her dash into your area. Choose a supported countergank instead of chasing through her wave.
draftInteractions.response: Irelia can wait out the area or fight with ordinary attacks. Dash denial does not erase her stacked passive or guarantee an early duel.

draftInteractions.plan: Keep Steadfast Presence for a visible dash into your area during a gank. Leave a walking retreat instead of using every cooldown to push the lane.
draftInteractions.response: Lee Sin can change his approach or wait for the denial to end. This does not stop every form of movement or make an overextended lane safe.

draftInteractions.plan: Prepare Unraveled Earth across a likely dash approach when Lee Sin is visible. Keep your exit open and avoid spending all your control just to clear the wave.
draftInteractions.response: Lee Sin can approach from another angle or wait for the field to expire. A prepared zone does not replace river information.

draftInteractions.plan: Face Bullet Time with Unbreakable and position between the shots and your carry. The shield reduces incoming damage; Braum still needs health and a safe exit.
draftInteractions.response: Miss Fortune can wait for the shield or change her firing angle. Do not spend Unbreakable on minor poke just before an ultimate fight.

draftInteractions.plan: Place Black Shield on the intended arrow target before impact. Its control protection depends on the shield remaining intact.
draftInteractions.response: Ashe can threaten another target or coordinate magic damage to break the shield. A late shield does not undo control already applied.

draftInteractions.plan: Hold Howling Gale and Monsoon specifically for Samira's Wild Rush and Inferno Trigger; both displacements immediately interrupt her channeled ultimate, and Monsoon knockback cannot be blocked by Blade Whirl.
draftInteractions.response: Samira can wait for your defensive cooldowns or enter from a flank after an ally baits your ultimate. Avoid using your crowd control casually on minion poke.

draftInteractions.plan: Never trigger Inferno Trigger while Janna holds Howling Gale or Monsoon; both displacements immediately cancel your ultimate channel and clear your Style rank, and Blade Whirl cannot block Monsoon knockback. Let your frontline bait her disengage before committing Wild Rush.
draftInteractions.response: Janna will hold Monsoon and point-blank tornadoes for your ultimate. Coordinate with heavy engage to force her peel before you commit.

draftInteractions.plan: Track Xayah's Feather Storm before committing your all-in. Her ultimate untargetability negates your Inferno Trigger burst, and diving forward in a straight line invites a lethal Bladecaller root. Bait Feather Storm with short trades before using Wild Rush.
draftInteractions.response: Xayah will hold Feather Storm specifically to cancel your ultimate. If she casts it, disengage immediately and reset rather than chasing through placed feathers.

draftInteractions.plan: Hold polymorph for a targetable Yi after he commits to your carry. Coordinate follow-up during the brief control window.
draftInteractions.response: Yi can wait out polymorph or use untargetability to complicate its timing. Spending Whimsy on an ally attack buff removes that defensive option.

draftInteractions.plan: Keep Steadfast Presence for a Rocket Jump that passes through your protection area. Position near the carry you intend to defend.
draftInteractions.response: Tristana can hold her jump or approach outside the zone. Dash denial is temporary and does not prevent her ordinary ranged attacks.

draftInteractions.plan: Use your 650 attack range and Headshot to punish Vayne whenever she steps up to last-hit. Place Yordle Snap Traps along lane choke points and under tower to deny her safe farm.
draftInteractions.response: Vayne must concede contested minions early and farm safely near turret until Final Hour and Silver Bolts are leveled. Never roll forward with Tumble into Caitlyn's 90 Caliber Net reach.

draftInteractions.plan: Force early all-in skirmishes with Spinning Axes before Jinx gets items; your raw auto-attack burst out-trades her minigun and rockets. Use Stand Aside to interrupt her escape or peel.
draftInteractions.response: Jinx should avoid fighting in Draven's axe range early on. Place Flame Chompers behind you to zone him off his axe catch paths and play for late-game teamfight resets.

draftInteractions.plan: Hold Whimsy polymorph and Wild Growth for Zed the exact moment he emerges behind your carry from Death Mark. Polymorph cancels his burst combo completely.
draftInteractions.response: Zed must bait Lulu's Whimsy before committing his ultimate, or enter on a different target away from her protective cast range.

draftInteractions.plan: Raise Unbreakable directly into Lucian's The Culling to absorb every projectile and protect your team. Step forward with Concussive Blows to punish his short attack reach.
draftInteractions.response: Lucian must reposition with Relentless Pursuit to change firing angles around Braum's shield, or hold The Culling until Unbreakable is dropped.

draftInteractions.plan: Cast Black Shield on whichever teammate Blitzcrank targets with Rocket Grab to completely negate the pull and displacement. Follow up with Dark Binding while his hook is on cooldown.
draftInteractions.response: Blitzcrank must walk up aggressively to bait Black Shield onto the wrong target before throwing Rocket Grab, or use Overdrive to close into melee Power Fist range.

draftInteractions.plan: Use Double Up to bounce shots off minions into Ezreal and stack Make It Rain slow to prevent Arcane Shift repositioning. Bullet Time deals massive damage when Ezreal must stay close to contest an objective and cannot shift away safely.
draftInteractions.response: Ezreal should use Arcane Shift preemptively to dodge Double Up bounces and trade only with Mystic Shot from maximum range. Never let Miss Fortune channel Bullet Time in choke points without using Trueshot Barrage or support crowd control to interrupt.

draftInteractions.plan: Use Ambush camouflage to approach from a flank angle outside Caitlyn's trap sight lines, then trigger Spray and Pray in her direction before she can place Yordle Snap Trap reactively. The attack range boost and pierce ignore her 90 Caliber Net escape if you open on top of her.
draftInteractions.response: Caitlyn should pre-place Yordle Snap Traps in all likely Twitch camouflage approach angles and rely on Piltover Peacemaker poke to whittle his health before he can reveal himself. Use 90 Caliber Net the instant Ambush ends to create distance.

draftInteractions.plan: Use Killer Instinct to enter behind Xayah when she has already spent Feather Storm, guaranteeing your full burst lands without being negated by her untargetability. Stack Icathian Rain on Void Seeker-marked targets to evolve abilities faster and outpace Xayah's scaling.
draftInteractions.response: Hold Feather Storm specifically for Kai'Sa's Killer Instinct arrival — the untargetability window prevents her from landing Icathian Rain during her entrance. Place feathers in Kai'Sa's landing zone so Bladecaller roots her immediately after Feather Storm ends.

draftInteractions.plan: Use Boomerang Blade and Ricochet to dominate early wave control and prevent Vayne from safely farming close enough to proc Silver Bolts. Reserve Spell Shield for Condemn to stay off walls and avoid the true-damage setup.
draftInteractions.response: Vayne must use Tumble to dodge Boomerang Blade casts and farm through Sivir's push by staying near tower. Bait Spell Shield with a basic attack or support ability before attempting Condemn for a wall stun.

draftInteractions.plan: Outrange Miss Fortune with Fishbones rocket mode and place Flame Chompers across her Double Up bounce angles to prevent safe trading. A Jinx reset chain from Flame Chompers root into Super Mega Death Rocket can eliminate Miss Fortune before Bullet Time becomes available.
draftInteractions.response: Miss Fortune should stay at maximum range and use Make It Rain slow zones to prevent Jinx from repositioning freely between Fishbones and Pow-Pow modes. Avoid standing in choke points where Fishbones splash damage can hit multiple targets.

draftInteractions.plan: Save Feather Storm for the exact moment Samira activates Inferno Trigger to drop all targeting and become untargetable throughout her channel. Pull all placed feathers with Bladecaller to root Samira mid-dash when she attempts Wild Rush.
draftInteractions.response: Samira must never trigger Inferno Trigger while Xayah holds Feather Storm. Bait out Feather Storm with short trades and use Blade Whirl to destroy incoming feathers before Xayah can recall them with Bladecaller.

globalConditions.text: Judge both enemy laners together. Trade when your partner can follow, protect your health before a reset and avoid pushing blind.
Match your carry’s wave state. Contest space when they can trade; roam after a safe crash or recall rather than leaving them under a stacked wave.
Use wave priority to decide whether you can move first. Ping missing enemies and compare the cost of a roam with the wave you would lose.
Choose your route around nearby lane pressure and likely enemy movement. Take supported ganks; do not repeatedly abandon camps for low-probability plays.
Trade with the wave and your escape route in mind. Track the enemy jungler before extending, and do not spend all your health for a small farm lead.

pc.label: League PC
pc.summary: Caitlyn and Jinx lose scaling power; Miss Fortune receives compensation buffs. Ranged Hubris and Gluttonous Greaves are nerfed. Includes the October 22 Varus hotfix. Summoner’s Rift only.

changes.Caitlyn: Less late-game Headshot damage; higher Q base damage at later ranks.
changes.Jinx: Lower starting health and attack damage growth.
changes.Miss Fortune: More E damage and stronger ultimate critical damage.
changes.Varus: October 22: Q multi-target bug fixed; passive scaling and minimum Q damage increased.
changes.Darius: Shorter Q cooldown at maximum rank.
changes.Lee Sin: Longer W cooldown and lower ultimate damage.
changes.Locke: Mana and sustain adjustments alongside stronger E scaling.
changes.Nidalee: Lower cougar W damage and E attack speed.
changes.Orianna: Higher Q and W ability power ratios.

championData.tips: Space your blade edges and extend trades only while your healing can keep you in the fight.
championData.caution: Missed sweet spots and repeated disengage make long trades difficult.
championData.spikePlan: Look for a fight after a useful purchase and with your important cooldowns ready. Most champions unlock their ultimate at level 5; confirm your champion’s exceptions and the opponent’s level before committing. Timings and items are game-specific.
championData.counterplay: Move out of blade edges and avoid extending a trade once he can repeatedly heal from hits.
championData.keyWindow: Dash and blade sequence; punish after the final swing rather than during a ready combo.

goodAgainst.name: Vladimir

badAgainst.name: Darius

badAgainst.name: Garen

draftRules.label: A way to contest repeated poke

draftRules.advice: Wave-clear tools give you a way to manage pressure from {targets}. Respect summons, resources and missing enemies; clearing a wave does not establish a winning duel.

draftRules.advice: Use defensive control to break up the extended fight or first takedown sought by {targets}. Play near allied follow-up rather than forcing an isolated duel.

draftRules.label: Reposition around their control
draftRules.advice: Preserve movement to reposition around {targets} after a control spell is spent. This is an escape option, not immunity or evidence that you can invade safely.

draftRules.label: Escape option against lane control
draftRules.advice: Keep your movement available for the catch attempt from {targets}. Use it to preserve spacing, not to assume their control cannot hit you.

draftRules.label: Catch opportunity in lane

draftRules.label: Can interrupt an extended trade

draftRules.label: Wave and reset option

draftRules.label: Damage for a longer trade

draftRules.label: Escape option against the shown jungler
draftRules.advice: Save your movement when {targets} can approach your lane. Ward an entrance and keep the wave on a side with a retreat; mobility alone does not prevent a gank.

draftRules.label: Defensive response to the shown jungler

draftRules.label: Repeated damage into durability

draftRules.label: Earlier map-pressure option

draftRules.label: Opponent can disrupt your entry

draftInteractions.plan: Keep the dash-stopping area available when covering a lane threatened by Irelia. Position around the teammate you can actually protect.
draftInteractions.response: Irelia can bait the cooldown or continue attacking without dashing. Check nearby allies before committing to the countergank.

draftInteractions.plan: Build armor and use Unstoppable Force to close the distance to Jinx before she can reposition. Your Thunderclap armor-scaling burst makes trades lethal once you reach her, and Ground Slam cripples her attack speed during the fight.
draftInteractions.response: Jinx should hold Flame Chompers behind Malphite to zone him off his engage path and stay behind enough allied protection that his Unstoppable Force has no isolated landing target. Use Zap! to slow him before he enters ultimate range.

draftInteractions.plan: Use Powerball to close the gap before Jinx can set up defensive traps, then activate Defensive Ball Curl to reflect her minigun damage and apply Frenzying Taunt to lock her in place while your team finishes her.
draftInteractions.response: Jinx must place Flame Chompers preemptively in Rammus's approach path to interrupt Powerball before he reaches melee range. If caught by Frenzying Taunt, she cannot use Super Mega Death Rocket; hold Zap! to slow his initial roll.

draftInteractions.plan: Reserve enemy-targeted Frozen Tomb for Samira when she commits within reach. Its stun gives your team a control window during a close-range fight.
draftInteractions.response: Samira can wait for your ultimate or attack from another angle. Self-casting the ultimate uses the same resource and does not apply its targeted stun to her.

draftInteractions.plan: Hold Howling Gale and Monsoon specifically for Samira's Wild Rush and Inferno Trigger; both displacements immediately interrupt her channeled ultimate, and Monsoon knockback cannot be blocked by Blade Whirl.
draftInteractions.response: Samira can wait for your defensive cooldowns or enter from a flank after an ally baits your ultimate. Avoid using your crowd control casually on minion poke.

draftInteractions.plan: Never trigger Inferno Trigger while Janna holds Howling Gale or Monsoon; both displacements immediately cancel your ultimate channel and clear your Style rank, and Blade Whirl cannot block Monsoon knockback. Let your frontline bait her disengage before committing Wild Rush.
draftInteractions.response: Janna will hold Monsoon and point-blank tornadoes for your ultimate. Coordinate with heavy engage to force her peel before you commit.

draftInteractions.plan: Track Xayah's Feather Storm before committing your all-in. Her ultimate untargetability negates your Inferno Trigger burst, and diving forward in a straight line invites a lethal Bladecaller root. Bait Feather Storm with short trades before using Wild Rush.
draftInteractions.response: Xayah will hold Feather Storm specifically to cancel your ultimate. If she casts it, disengage immediately and reset rather than chasing through placed feathers.

draftInteractions.plan: Position Steadfast Presence between Tristana and your carry to deny her Rocket Jump escape or engagement; a stopped jump wastes her primary repositioning tool. Follow up with Heroic Charge to pin her against terrain when she is grounded.
draftInteractions.response: Tristana can hold Rocket Jump and trade with basic attacks until Steadfast Presence expires, then jump to safety. Use Buster Shot to push Poppy away when she attempts Heroic Charge terrain stuns.

draftInteractions.plan: Use your 650 attack range and Headshot to punish Vayne whenever she steps up to last-hit. Place Yordle Snap Traps along lane choke points and under tower to deny her safe farm.
draftInteractions.response: Vayne must concede contested minions early and farm safely near turret until Final Hour and Silver Bolts are leveled. Never roll forward with Tumble into Caitlyn's 90 Caliber Net reach.

draftInteractions.plan: Force early all-in skirmishes with Spinning Axes before Jinx gets items; your raw auto-attack burst out-trades her minigun and rockets. Use Stand Aside to interrupt her escape or peel.
draftInteractions.response: Jinx should avoid fighting in Draven's axe range early on. Place Flame Chompers behind you to zone him off his axe catch paths and play for late-game teamfight resets.

draftInteractions.plan: Hold Whimsy polymorph and Wild Growth for Zed the exact moment he emerges behind your carry from Death Mark. Polymorph cancels his burst combo completely.
draftInteractions.response: Zed must bait Lulu's Whimsy before committing his ultimate, or enter on a different target away from her protective cast range.

draftInteractions.plan: Raise Unbreakable directly into Lucian's The Culling to absorb every projectile and protect your team. Step forward with Concussive Blows to punish his short attack reach.
draftInteractions.response: Lucian must reposition with Relentless Pursuit to change firing angles around Braum's shield, or hold The Culling until Unbreakable is dropped.

draftInteractions.plan: Cast Black Shield on whichever teammate Blitzcrank targets with Rocket Grab to completely negate the pull and displacement. Follow up with Dark Binding while his hook is on cooldown.
draftInteractions.response: Blitzcrank must walk up aggressively to bait Black Shield onto the wrong target before throwing Rocket Grab, or use Overdrive to close into melee Power Fist range.

draftInteractions.plan: Use Double Up to bounce shots off minions into Ezreal and stack Make It Rain slow to prevent Arcane Shift repositioning. Bullet Time deals massive damage when Ezreal must stay close to contest an objective and cannot shift away safely.
draftInteractions.response: Ezreal should use Arcane Shift preemptively to dodge Double Up bounces and trade only with Mystic Shot from maximum range. Never let Miss Fortune channel Bullet Time in choke points without using Trueshot Barrage or support crowd control to interrupt.

draftInteractions.plan: Use Boomerang Blade and Ricochet to dominate early wave control and prevent Vayne from safely farming close enough to proc Silver Bolts. Reserve Spell Shield for Condemn to stay off walls and avoid the true-damage setup.
draftInteractions.response: Vayne must use Tumble to dodge Boomerang Blade casts and farm through Sivir's push by staying near tower. Bait Spell Shield with a basic attack or support ability before attempting Condemn for a wall stun.

draftInteractions.plan: Outrange Miss Fortune with Fishbones rocket mode and place Flame Chompers across her Double Up bounce angles to prevent safe trading. A Jinx reset chain from Flame Chompers root into Super Mega Death Rocket can eliminate Miss Fortune before Bullet Time becomes available.
draftInteractions.response: Miss Fortune should stay at maximum range and use Make It Rain slow zones to prevent Jinx from repositioning freely between Fishbones and Pow-Pow modes. Avoid standing in choke points where Fishbones splash damage can hit multiple targets.

draftInteractions.plan: Save Feather Storm for the exact moment Samira activates Inferno Trigger to drop all targeting and become untargetable throughout her channel. Pull all placed feathers with Bladecaller to root Samira mid-dash when she attempts Wild Rush.
draftInteractions.response: Samira must never trigger Inferno Trigger while Xayah holds Feather Storm. Bait out Feather Storm with short trades and use Blade Whirl to destroy incoming feathers before Xayah can recall them with Bladecaller.

globalConditions.text: Judge both enemy laners together. Trade when your partner can follow, protect your health before a reset and avoid pushing blind.
Match your carry’s wave state. Contest space when they can trade; roam after a safe crash or recall rather than leaving them under a stacked wave.
Use wave priority to decide whether you can move first. Ping missing enemies and compare the cost of a roam with the wave you would lose.
Choose your route around nearby lane pressure and likely enemy movement. Take supported ganks; do not repeatedly abandon camps for low-probability plays.
Trade with the wave and your escape route in mind. Track the enemy jungler before extending, and do not spend all your health for a small farm lead.

wr.label: Wild Rift
wr.summary: Jhin gets earlier damage; Yunara and Senna lose damage. Cheaper Statikk Shiv and Yun Tal change purchase timings. Tank supports gain a cheaper, healthier Locket. Changes alone do not establish the best picks.

changes.Jhin: Higher standard critical damage; missing-health damage caps at level 10 instead of 15.
changes.Yunara: Lower first-ability damage; longer ultimate cooldown at later ranks.
changes.Senna: Lower critical damage, attack damage per soul and first-ability base damage.
changes.Volibear: More second-ability attack damage scaling and empowered healing.
changes.Tryndamere: Consistent critical chance per Fury and higher Spinning Slash damage.
changes.Hwei: Reduced passive damage, shielding and some spell damage/range.
changes.Nocturne: Lower health growth, reduced early first-ability damage and longer ultimate cooldown.
changes.Yasuo: Higher critical damage and stronger scaling shield.

strategyMeta.basis: Editorial kit and team-composition analysis. No rank-specific win rates, statistical counter claims or guaranteed builds. Role lists are conservative supported roles, not all possible off-meta choices.

meta.methodology: Every listed champion has editorial solo-queue guidance, counterplay and a cooldown/resource to track. Role plans and selected interactions explain opportunities, not measured counters. Scores reflect shown team composition, not win probabilities. PC kit references and game-specific patch summaries are separate from strategic inference. Named matchup coverage remains limited; unlisted matchups are unknown, not neutral. Legacy 7.1g rules are no longer used.

pc.label: League PC
pc.summary: Caitlyn and Jinx lose scaling power; Miss Fortune receives compensation buffs. Ranged Hubris and Gluttonous Greaves are nerfed. Includes the October 22 Varus hotfix. Summoner’s Rift only.

changes.Caitlyn: Less late-game Headshot damage; higher Q base damage at later ranks.
changes.Jinx: Lower starting health and attack damage growth.
changes.Miss Fortune: More E damage and stronger ultimate critical damage.
changes.Varus: October 22: Q multi-target bug fixed; passive scaling and minimum Q damage increased.
changes.Darius: Shorter Q cooldown at maximum rank.
changes.Lee Sin: Longer W cooldown and lower ultimate damage.
changes.Locke: Mana and sustain adjustments alongside stronger E scaling.
changes.Nidalee: Lower cougar W damage and E attack speed.
changes.Orianna: Higher Q and W ability power ratios.

draftChecklist: Choose the game first: champion availability, items, runes and balance differ.
Judge the full bot duo: range, engage, sustain, wave control and jungle pressure.
Plan your first purchase and power spike; avoid copying timings between games.
Check team damage mix, frontline and peel before locking a carry.
Prefer a practiced champion when matchup evidence is limited.
